title: Affine Proj
statement:
For an $\mathbb N$-graded commutative ring $R$, let $\operatorname{Proj}(R)$
be the projective-spectrum scheme [def-pc-proj] whose points are the homogeneous prime ideals of $R$ not
containing the irrelevant ideal $R_+$, with the Zariski topology and the
structure sheaf whose stalks are the degree-zero homogeneous localizations,
together with its structural morphism to $\operatorname{Spec}(R_0)$.
Here the stalk localization at $\mathfrak p$ consists of fractions
$a/s$ with $a$ and $s$ homogeneous of the same degree and
$s\notin\mathfrak p$, modulo equality in the ordinary localization
$R_{\mathfrak p}$; the structure sheaf is the usual sheaf of sections
locally represented by such fractions.
For a homogeneous element $f$ of positive degree, its standard open
$D_+(f)$ is identified with $\operatorname{Spec}(R_{(f),0})$
[def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], and for a family of
elements of $R$ whose span contains $R_+$ the standard opens $D_+(f_i)$
cover $\operatorname{Proj}(R)$.
